body.statement: Suppose \(K\) is row-stochastic and satisfies \(d_K(A)\geq\pi(A)\) for every nonempty \(A\subseteq\Omega\). If the true fixed schedule belongs to \(\Theta_{r,c}(X,Y^{\mathrm{obs}})\), then for every \(\alpha\in[0,1]\), \(\Pr_{X\sim\pi}\{p^{\mathrm{wc}}_{r,c}(X)\leq\alpha\}\leq\alpha\).
body.justification: Pointwise maximization over null-consistent sharp schedules preserves finite-sample design validity.
body.gap: Caughey et al. establish bounded-null validity without network coupling, while Owusu's network heterogeneity procedure is asymptotic.
body.consumer: Applied researchers obtain exact finite-population statements about how many farmers have direct effects above a scientifically chosen threshold.
